name: Frostmane tribe
summary: Across Dun Morogh’s frigid peaks, the Frostmane tribe fights to reclaim its home. These ice trolls are native to the mountains, but dwarves drove them into caves and remote ridges centuries ago. From there, the Frostmane wage a guerrilla war against the dwarves.

sections.title: Exiles of the High Crags
sections.body: Long before the Bronzebeard clan united under Ironforge, the Frostmane trolls ruled across Dun Morogh’s snowbound reaches. The rise and spread of the dwarven kingdom crushed their realm, forcing survivors to retreat into caves and along frozen ridges and crags. That defeat bred a bitter hatred passed down through generations. To the Frostmane, every mountaineer, traveler, and homestead is an invader to drive out or slaughter.

sections.title: A Seized Opportunity
sections.body: For decades, the Ironforge Senate saw the Frostmane as little more than a nuisance in the hills. Then the trogg menace emerged deep beneath Dun Morogh, throwing dwarven defenses into disarray. With the mountaineers overwhelmed and dwarven forces fighting Alliance wars abroad, the Frostmane seized their chance. From strongholds such as Frostmane Hold and Shimmer Ridge, they launched renewed, violent raids to reclaim their ancient lands.

sections.title: Raiders of the Valleys
sections.body: The Senate of Ironforge eventually recognized the growing danger and sent Grelin Whitebeard and his brother Senir to confront it. From the caves of Frostmane Hold and the heights of Shimmer Ridge, the trolls strike at dwarves. In Coldridge Valley, war leaders such as Grik'nir the Cold direct aggressive incursions against the mountaineers.

faq.answer: The Frostmane are ice trolls native to Dun Morogh’s snowy crags. They ruled the region until dwarven armies defeated them centuries ago and forced them into the high ridges.

faq.q: Why are the Frostmane attacking the dwarves now?
faq.answer: Trogg invasions have strained the dwarven mountaineers, while their forces fight Alliance wars abroad. The Frostmane see an opening to reclaim their ancestral hunting grounds and take revenge on Ironforge.
The Frostmane raid from Frostmane Hold and Shimmer Ridge. In Coldridge Valley, war leaders such as Grik'nir the Cold lead bands that harry the dwarves.

Frostmane Hold remains a troll stronghold in the hills of Dun Morogh, and the Frostmane launch raids from its caves. The Senate of Ironforge sent Grelin Whitebeard and his brother Senir to deal with the threat.

faq.q: What is Shimmerweed, and why do the trolls gather it?
faq.answer: Shimmerweed is a hardy plant that grows in the bitter winds of Shimmer Ridge. The Frostmane cultivate and harvest it for sacred tribal rituals, while dwarven brewers prize it as an ingredient in potent stout.

faq.q: Are the Frostmane aligned with the Horde?
faq.answer: No. The Frostmane are independent ice trolls who hate outsiders and attack travelers and explorers regardless of faction.

angles.text: For dwarves, the Frostmane recall ancestral blood feuds, making the mountaineers’ defense of Dun Morogh deeply personal.

As a Darkspear troll, you share the broad heritage of trollkind, but the isolated Frostmane are savage ice trolls with little interest in kinship. They treat Horde visitors as intruders on their sacred peaks.
Crag boars and other beasts kept around Frostmane encampments provide rough game meat for hearthside rations amid Dun Morogh’s biting snows.
